parents.subject: Food Science and Human Nutrition
parents.course: Advanced Topics in Food Science and Human Nutrition

ns2:section.sectionText: This section of FSHN 595 requires registered students to have successfully completed a physics or a calculus course at the undergraduate level.***The course will cover heat and fluid transport concepts for solving problems of importance to food and biological systems. Students will develop basic understanding of engineering models for working with these problems and obtain the solution using the finite element method with help of a software package. The overall focus will be to develop an understanding of an advanced computational tool that could be combined with the experimental data for optimizing the transport processes and understanding the underlying physical mechanisms.
